name: HANNAH SATTERLY REEVE
bioAdditions: Akerly (1898): Hannah, daughter of Maj. James Reeve of Mattituck, was the wife of Joshua Tuthill (b. 1690, d. 2 June 1782) of Cutchogue. She died 8 Mar 1764, aged 64 (S1). She was not the wife of James Tuthill, as the tree has it.
